hook.description: The opening close-up of a cold, ruthless man looking down at a woman, followed by a curt 'Good.', creates immediate tension, but no stakes are yet clear to a first-time viewer.

cliffhanger.description: The clip ends with Rupert nervously stressing that everything must go perfectly as the wedding is about to begin, while the Harringtons watch with a knowing smirk. The outcome of the wedding is not shown, so the tension is left open.

promos.why_it_works: Cold, smug villains gloat in a church as a nervous groom-side figure fears the wedding will go wrong, leaving the outcome unresolved.
